verdict.rationale: Mesh case management supports assigning cases and filtering by assignee and case stage (docs-6, starter-assignment), and analysts record case decisions with an audit trail. Escalation is documented only as AI agents automatically escalating high-risk or complex cases for human review, not as an operations-configurable routing of cases through analyst and escalation stages. Missing for 10: documented configurable multi-stage review/escalation workflow (e.g. manual escalation, second-level or four-eyes approval stages), detail on how stages are defined and transitioned, independent or hands-on corroboration.
